results.title: Diphtheria Outbreak Claims 1,260 Lives, 41,000 Suspected Cases Recorded In Nigeria
results.content: More than 1,260 people have died from diphtheria in Nigeria since the outbreak began in late 2022, with over 41,000 suspected cases and more than 24,000 confirmed infections recorded nationwide. Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF), also known as Doctors Without Borders, disclosed this in a press statement issued by its Field Communication Officer, Abdulkareem Yakubu. The organisation warned that shortages of diphtheria antitoxin (DAT) and low vaccination coverage were worsening the outbreak, particularly in northern Nigeria, putting thousands of children at risk of severe illness […]
